defects.title: An included species named as an ion makes the main species of the same index an ION
defects.trigger: complete-structure map (rxnReactantLineColor present) with an included species named 'Na_plus_' at index 1 and main species 1 'glc[c]' (SIMPLE_MOLECULE)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-15) newmap.specType = {'ION','PROTEIN','COMPLEX'}: line 166 writes specType{m}, m indexes specIncName
defects.expected: specType{1} stays SIMPLE_MOLECULE; specIncType{1} = 'ION' (as lines 188-190 do for non-ions)

notes: Repro: map.rxnName={'R1';'R2'}; map.rxnColor={'ffff0000';'ffff0000'}; map.rxnWidth={'5.0';'5.0'}; map.rxnReactantLineColor={{'ffff0000';'ffff0000'};''}; map.rxnReactantLineWidth={{'5.0';'5.0'};''}; map.rxnProductLineColor={'';{'ffff0000'}}; map.rxnProductLineWidth={'';{'5.0'}}; map.specID={'s1';'s2';'s3'}; map.specName={'glc[c]';'hk';'cplx'}; map.specType={'SIMPLE_MOLECULE';'PROTEIN';'COMPLEX'}; map.molID={'s1';'s2';'s4'}; map.molColor={'a';'b';'c'}; map.molWidth={'1';'1';'1'}; map.molHeight={'1';'1';'1'}; map.specIncID={'s4'}; map.specIncName={'Na_plus_'}; map.specIncType={'ION'}; newmap=defaultLookMap(map); newmap.specType  % -> {'ION';'PROTEIN';'COMPLEX'}. No src/ caller (only tutorials). Also observed: rxnWidth is set to the number 1.0 although map widths are text (not recorded as a defect). Probed: regexp(cellstr, 1x1 cell pattern) works, so the other loops run.
